title: Concept: Change data capture connectors exposed
description: A connector list that names the databases being replicated in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The list names every captured database and often the connection string behind it, which is both the data map and a credential hint.
applicability: Deployments that render a connector list that names the databases being replicated into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The list names every captured database and often the connection string behind it, which is both the data map and a credential hint.
